numerical_disposition: All accurate graph/candidate arms pass independent scale screen; prior XLA fails and is excluded from speed ratios.
cost_disposition: Graph-to-graph parity is eligible. Candidate XLA cold/host triggers require lifecycle/capacity attribution; GPU allocator and process reservation are recorded separately.
ownership_disposition: Caller program, graph, callback, owner and resource collect in every measured worker; reusable primitive graph retention is explicit and bounded by worker lifetime.
nonclaims: No native executable eviction or broad capacity claim.
No default-readiness, posterior, HMC or scientific superiority claim.
No prior-XLA timing ratio because its numerical result is inaccurate.
